name: Wizard’s Vengeance VR: Magic Horror
summary: Your sanctuary is destroyed. Your magic has been stolen by a cursed enemy. Enter a haunted building packed with dark rooms, locked cabinets, hidden keys, and lurking zombies. Collect potions, attach magic stones, and cast spells with your VR magic wand as a wizard on a vengeance mission. Fight monsters, hunt the cursed villain room by room, and survive a dark fantasy VR magic horror adventure with spell casting, potion hunting, and survival horror for Meta Quest.
